facts.text: Serve the main when the inn opens for Thanksgiving and the turkey shows up.
facts.why: At Thanksgiving the inn is closed and Jim is wallowing in self-pity. The film's Thanksgiving joke is an animated calendar turkey running between the third and fourth Thursdays.
facts.fix: Serve the main when the calendar turkey can't pick a Thursday for Thanksgiving.

facts.text: Easter at the inn, the night Jim and Linda dance to Easter Parade
facts.why: Wikipedia only says romance blossoms between Jim and Linda at Easter. The song Easter Parade is in the film, but nothing opened shows the two dancing to it.
facts.fix: Easter at the inn, when romance blossoms for Jim and Linda

facts.why: The transcript has the Holiday Inn ad reading 'Midville, Connecticut' and 'Open holidays only'.

vibe.verdict: Lovely postcard motel look that fits the inn, with the holiday calendar idea used well.
